# semaphore_ex_project_integration_extract_value (Data Source)

Manage or read a value extracted from incoming integration requests into task parameters or environment variables.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_project_integration_extract_value" "commit" {
  project_id     = 1
  integration_id = 2
  id             = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Extracted-value rule ID assigned by Semaphore EX. Value must be at least 1.
- `integration_id` (Number) Integration containing the rule. Value must be at least 1.
- `project_id` (Number) Project containing the integration. Value must be at least 1.

### Read-Only

- `body_data_type` (String) Interpretation of the request body.
- `key` (String) Header name or JSON field path. Empty only when extracting the entire string body.
- `name` (String) Rule name.
- `value_source` (String) Request component to extract from.
- `variable` (String) Destination environment variable or task parameter name.
- `variable_type` (String) Destination type.
